description: Managed here: GitHub Actions, both pinned ruff versions (validate.yml and requirements_test.txt), and the test harness.

Deliberately not managed: caldav, icalendar and vobject. Home Assistant installs them into the same environment as the built-in caldav integration, so they must match the versions core pins, not the latest release on PyPI. They live in manifest.json and are mirrored in requirements_test.txt; the rule below leaves them alone in both.

packageRules.description: Mirrors the manifest.json pins, which follow Home Assistant core.
One PR for both ruff pins, so CI and the local venv cannot drift apart. Last of the three, because a later rule wins per field and the catch-all above matches ruff in requirements_test.txt too.
